Meaning: Implementation status is not an execution pass. The gate also requires all controlled samples, independent clients, parity, appearance, studio and lifecycle receipts.

Requirements.Proof: 66 controlled samples per adapter plus parity-all and deterministic

Requirements.Requirement: Rich/code text, syntax colours, Unicode/complex shaping
Requirements.Proof: rich and unicode-bidi geometry and decoded RTF/Xaml style comparisons

Requirements.Requirement: Tables: alignment, wrapping, row/cell geometry and selection
Requirements.Proof: table, table-wrap and mixed comparisons/independent clients

Requirements.Requirement: Spanning cells and nested block content in tables
Requirements.Proof: Complete span geometry and cell block flow, UIA grid spans/relationships and public interchange; table-spans/table-blocks stock geometry/style checks and extended-table-uia execution required

Requirements.Requirement: Quotes, details, headings, outline and internal links
Requirements.Proof: targeted parity, independent rich client and studio-checks

Requirements.Requirement: Workspace images, Mermaid geometry and native commands
Requirements.Proof: mixed media geometry, independent zoom/source copy; actual SVG/PNG save dialogues and decoded output: media-checks

99da420: both hosted independent clients activate actual stock/candidate child/back links, real external confirmation Cancel/OK and the exact default-browser destination nonce; workspace bytes unchanged. link-checks repeats at the evaluated head.

Requirements.Requirement: Mouse/keyboard selection, transformed source spans, range lifetime
Requirements.Proof: independent clients, deterministic source assertions, studio replacement and lifecycle

Requirements.Requirement: Visual-direction keyboard caret movement within bidirectional runs
Requirements.StockEquivalentScope: Stock read-only unshifted arrows scroll without moving its selected insertion point; Shift extends selection through mixed Latin/Arabic, combining and surrogate text. A separate caret-browsing feature is not demonstrated by stock and is not claimed. The original broader requirement wording is retained.
Requirements.Proof: 943 independently recorded stock/candidate operations agree on both 88b07cb and 99da420 hosted replications, including 54 unshifted and 54 Shift arrow steps plus 16 other key vectors. range-checks defines the demonstrated product scope.

Requirements.Requirement: Exact selected plain text, decoded RTF/Xaml and whole-document CF_HTML
Requirements.Proof: stock serialisation oracles, parity-all styles, actual independent copy and HTML decoding

Requirements.Requirement: All partial-range list marker/tab cases and XamlPackage media fidelity
Requirements.Proof: Stock oracles compare within-run, partial cross-item, whole item without break, next-item insertion, final-item partial and partial cross-cell text plus decoded RTF/Xaml styles. Actual list partial copying and mixed XamlPackage decoding pass both 99da420 independent clients.
Requirements.StockEquivalentScope: Public stock XamlPackage contains twelve inline bitmaps with matching decoded pixels; it omits the block diagram on both routes. Whole-document CF_HTML retains all thirteen media through the existing exporter. This omission is explicit, not claimed media parity beyond stock.

Requirements.Requirement: UIA document/list/table/heading/link tree, selection and measured ranges
Requirements.Proof: independent UIA clients, cell/header relationships, point/off-screen/visible bounds and ScrollIntoView

Requirements.Requirement: Complete stock-oracle TextUnit and text-attribute range operation matrix
Requirements.Proof: range-checks: all seven TextUnits, counts -2/-1/0/1/2, both endpoints, collapsed/non-collapsed ranges, clone/compare, selection errors and thirteen attributes/FindAttribute in both directions. 943 complete independent operation records match stock on both 88b07cb and 99da420 hosts, including distant text.

Requirements.Requirement: Search, source navigation, anchors and transient document lifecycle
Requirements.Proof: studio-checks independent real input and lifecycle leading/distant edits

Requirements.Requirement: Light/Dark/automatic actual OS High Contrast transitions
Requirements.Proof: Hosted appearance test, every installation currency checked; no manual disable refresh

Requirements.Requirement: Queued/active cancellation and closure with separate observations
Requirements.Proof: lifecycle event timestamps, active closure/reopen and latest-version rejection

Requirements.Requirement: Stale failure and clipboard-close races; bounded retention across full studio stress
Requirements.Proof: 99da420 lifecycle: obsolete worker exception rejected, superseded copy cancelled before grant, queued OLE commit rejected after closure with unchanged clipboard sequence; explicit source/surface detachment. Independent studio client holds twelve invalidated ranges through twelve real replacements. Weak range/peer owners and bounded session/payload ownership; natural-GC observations do not certify zero retention or absence of leaks.

Requirements.Requirement: Visual equivalence review beyond measured logical/style/geometry assertions
Requirements.Proof: At f86d6df, 11/66 raster pairs per host are byte-identical. Other fixtures show text-edge, table-border and details-toggle paint differences; native toggle chrome correction requires new captures. Geometry/style agreement alone does not classify every raster difference.
